name: Sky Islands
living: the waterfalls pour off the island's edges (a slow scrolling shimmer on the painted water)
the hot-air balloons drift slowly upward and sideways
the little floating islands bob gently up and down
the clouds below the island drift slowly past
the low sun glows with a soft lens flare
pastel clouds drift across the sky (sky layer drift)
cottage windows on the floating islands light up warmly
the HOME RUN DERBY marquee bulbs chase around the board
a few birds glide between the islands now and then
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
